description: MySampark is a social media automation platform that manages Instagram and Facebook accounts using AI-powered workflows. The platform automates replies to comments, sends direct messages, and schedules content across multiple channels from a unified workspace. The AI campaign manager generates captions and hashtags for content planning. Comment-to-DM automation converts engagement into leads by responding to keyword triggers such as pricing inquiries.
